name: Mary's room (the family flat, Singapore): test level eval2, Packing Day from scratch; from the owner's photographs of 24 Oct 2026, not kept
setting: Cosy, warm and lived-in: a ten-year-old girl's narrow bedroom in a Singapore flat on a rainy December afternoon, empty of people.
palette: the walls are plain white, with no painted band; the band line is only the height of the sofa's back, 36% of the way up the back wall from the floor; the floor is pale honey-coloured wood with a striped rug (pale blue, green and cream stripes) down the middle; a dark stained-wood loft bed, a grey sofa, white and black furniture, cream curtains
box: a shallow box in one-point perspective: a wide back wall running the full width, narrow side walls, a thin strip of ceiling, a low floor band
light: the only daylight comes through the tall window on the window wall, a soft grey-green rainy afternoon light, with a warm ceiling light elsewhere

m3.name: the sofa wall (north)
m3.light: the window is to the right of this wall, so grey daylight comes from the right and shadows lean left; the wall is warm from the ceiling light

objects.label: tall educational poster
objects.text: high on the wall at the left, a long poster with a dark background and small coloured pictures of planets and rocks, with no readable words

objects.label: small framed print
objects.text: a small framed print with a wide white mat and a thin black frame, hanging above the middle of the sofa

objects.label: grey sofa with two cushions and an open suitcase
objects.text: a low grey sofa bed along the wall, with a cushion printed like an old world map and a green knitted cushion at its left end; on the seat at the right, an open child's suitcase with a purple lid, empty, its lid leaning against the sofa back
objects.size: its back at a grown-up's waist
objects.moves: single (the whiteboard: lifted and read, wiped at the end; the case: the lid pops as each thing goes in)
objects.absent: a low grey sofa bed along the wall, with a cushion printed like an old world map and a green knitted cushion at its left end, and the rest of the seat bare and smooth; nothing propped against its back
objects.cut: two things, each drawn alone: an open child's suitcase with a purple lid, seen from the front and a little above, empty inside; and a small white whiteboard in a thin frame with a black marker pen clipped to its edge, blank

objects.label: the edge of the curtain
objects.text: at the far right, where this wall meets the window wall, the edge of a cream curtain from ceiling to floor

m2.name: the window wall (east), to the right of the sofa wall
m2.light: grey rainy daylight fills this wall from the glass itself and lies in a soft patch on the floor; everything in front of the window is a little dark against it

objects.label: black music stand with a folder
objects.text: a black metal music stand on a tripod at the left, holding a closed blue cardboard folder; nothing wound round the stand
objects.size: the folder at a child's eye height
objects.moves: single (the pompom lights: code-drawn twinkle, switched off by a tap; the folder: flips open, lifted from the wall)
objects.absent: a black metal music stand on a tripod at the left, holding a closed blue cardboard folder; nothing wound round the stand, nothing hanging from it
objects.cut: a short string of small round pompom fairy lights in pastel colours, drawn alone as a loose loop, for the game to wind round the stand

objects.label: tall window with a deep ledge
objects.text: a tall window with a thin white frame in two parts: an upper pair of panes and a lower pane that opens, rain streaming down the glass; a deep white ledge between them with a row of books standing between two photo frames (their pictures unreadable) and a small blue-and-white patterned box; cream curtains drawn back to either side; beyond the glass the pale towers of neighbouring blocks and one big tree with dark glossy leaves close to the glass, soft in the rain
objects.size: from the floor almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: the end of the sofa
objects.text: at the far right, the end of the grey sofa with its green knitted cushion
objects.size: its back at a grown-up's waist

m1.name: the loft wall (south), opposite the sofa wall
m1.light: the window is to the left of this wall, so grey daylight comes from the left and shadows lean right; under the loft bed it is dimmer, warmed by the ceiling light

objects.label: dark wooden loft bed along the wall
objects.text: a loft bed in dark stained wood running the whole width of the wall: four thick square posts, a rail round the high bunk, a ladder at the left end, a mattress and a teal floral duvet up top, a rainbow and a white costume hung over the rail; small stickers on the posts; under it a cream ribbed padded panel on the wall at the right half
objects.size: the bunk at a grown-up's head height, the posts reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: under the loft's left end: a step stool and a stack of boxes
objects.text: under the loft at the far left, on the floor: a small low wooden step stool, and beside it two clear plastic storage tubs stacked one on the other
objects.size: the stool at a child's knee
objects.moves: single (the baby bath and the top tub: lifted aside to show the stool)
objects.absent: under the loft at the far left, on the floor: a small low wooden step stool standing in plain view, with nothing on or in front of it
objects.cut: two things, each drawn alone: a white plastic baby bath, seen from the side and a little above; and a clear plastic storage tub with a white lid, with soft toys faintly visible inside

objects.label: white cube unit under the loft
objects.text: under the loft, a white cube shelf unit two cubes wide and four high, full of children's books standing in rows, craft boxes, a wicker basket, plastic tubs and a pink sequinned handbag
objects.size: its top just under the bunk

objects.label: the padded panel with a drawing and a postcard
objects.text: on the ribbed padded panel under the loft, at the left above the desk: a small postcard pinned up, and beside it a blank space where a framed picture would hang; nothing hanging from the bunk's rail above it
objects.moves: single (the pocket organiser: swings, then its close-up; the framed drawing: lifted)
objects.absent: on the ribbed padded panel under the loft, at the left above the desk: a small postcard pinned up, and beside it a blank space where a framed picture would hang; nothing hanging from the bunk's rail above it
objects.cut: two things, each drawn alone: a grey fabric hanging organiser with two rows of pockets, the lower pockets with round clear windows, hung from a short loop; and a child's drawing of a grandmother and three children in felt-tip in a plain white frame

objects.label: black desk with green drawers and a white chair
objects.text: a black desk under the loft at the right, with three dark green drawers down its right side and a patterned fabric box in the cubby under them; on it a metal pot of pens and pencils, a yellow mug of paintbrushes and a sheet of paper; a white swivel chair with a purple seat cushion on wheels in front of it; above it on the padded panel two small square canvas family pictures, their faces soft and unreadable
objects.size: the desk top at a grown-up's waist

m4.name: the door wall (west), to the left of the sofa wall
m4.light: the window is behind the viewer, so this wall is lit evenly by the grey daylight from behind, with faint shadows straight back, and warm from the ceiling light

objects.label: the end of the loft bed
objects.text: at the far left, the end of the dark wooden loft bed with its ladder, and under it the stack of clear tubs
objects.size: the posts reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: tall white wardrobe
objects.text: a tall white wardrobe with two plain doors and two small silver handles, closed, reaching almost to the ceiling strip
objects.size: reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: the open door to the corridor
objects.text: the room's door at the right: a dark wooden door standing open into the room, and through the doorway a short white corridor with a pale stone floor and, far down it, a glimpse of daylight; two white light switches on the wall beside the frame and a few small notes pinned there
objects.size: the door reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: air-conditioning unit
objects.text: a white air-conditioning unit high on the wall above the door, in the ceiling strip
